review_scope: Frozen completed analysis and N/projection/readout evidence; no duplicated raw numerical audit, model or checkpoint reads. Not approval for any future execution.
analysis_definition: NLL(remove_write_matched)-NLL(orth_write_matched), nats per target; positive means PC edit has higher loss than the fixed orth edit, not necessarily higher loss than baseline.

claims.claim: Native000 matched PC-minus-fixed-orth full-view NLL contrast is positive on Wiki and negative on the other three sources, both starts.
claims.evidence: 8/8 nominal conditional 95% bootstrap CIs exclude zero; four passage clusters/source, one frozen F and one orth direction.

claims.claim: The contrast persists after approximate querywise matching of actual whole-L10 c_proj write-change Euclidean norms.
claims.evidence: All 256 RMS-domain checks pass 1e-5; finite operation contrast remains. This does not make magnitude irrelevant or exclude tiny residual mismatch explanations under unbounded downstream sensitivity.

claims.claim: The full-window source signs describe every position range.
claims.evidence: Ethics natural000 early positive CI excludes zero and later negative CI excludes zero; Wiki positive early, later mean negative with CI crossing zero; Code early positive mean with wide CI, later negative.

claims.claim: The full-view source/start sign pattern persists at zeroV111.
claims.evidence: 8/8 endpoint nominal CIs exclude zero. T20 tested only 000 and 111, not all eight T19 boundaries; endpoint differences and time effects remain.

claims.claim: Shared full-view signs prove BOS/natural invariance.
claims.evidence: Native000 paired start interactions exclude zero on Wiki, Ethics, Code. Two starts share four passage clusters and are not independent replications.

claims.claim: Norm matching does not affect the contrast.
claims.evidence: Matched-minus-full contrast changes exclude zero on Wiki and Ethics, both starts. No mediated fraction follows.

claims.claim: PC removal universally helps or uniquely causes the observed harm.
claims.evidence: Native matched PC raises Wiki mean loss; orth edit lowers Wiki loss; Util BOS PC-effect CI crosses zero; Ethics one of four full-view contrast signs reverses.

claims.claim: 776 planned forwards, 64 shards, 12 snapshots, 24 selected projections, 48 full-vocabulary rows were audited.
claims.evidence: Projection coordinates 9,437,184. Ordinary unsaved contexts/hidden/logits have recorded runtime guards, not full independent reconstruction. No 14-snapshot or all-vocabulary-row claim.

claims.claim: T20 proves a unique PC circuit, mediation, general sink mechanism, population benefit, generation or fidelity.
claims.evidence: Interventions support conditional operation effects only; single checkpoint/layer/F/orth direction, four passages/source and correlated unadjusted contrasts.

claims.claim: T20 first discovers norm-controlled direction dependence or sink implicit gating.
claims.evidence: Ran-Milo et al. Appendix B.1 already uses equal-coefficient direction swaps; Fu et al. v3 derives implicit gates and discusses multiple low-value sink components.

matching.norm_equality: approximate FP32, both q1..511 and scored q1..510; RMS maximum is not a pointwise maximum

simple_summary_consistency.bootstrap: Relies on independently passed N audit; no new bootstrap or tolerance fitting.

statistical_scope.cluster: four passages per corpus, paired starts/arms/boundaries share indices
statistical_scope.calibration: one fixed F, no fit/population calibration uncertainty
statistical_scope.multiplicity: unadjusted correlated contrasts, not independent replications
statistical_scope.effects: finite controlled operation contrasts; no mediation fraction/circuit uniqueness

literature.comparison: Appendix B.1 uses equal-coefficient EPE/PE component swaps, explicitly described as magnitude-preserving direction controls. Generic priority for norm-controlled direction dependence is unavailable. This differs from actual whole-L10 c_proj write-change norm matching here.

Section3.1/AppendixB derive the non-sink allocation gate under zero/negligible sink value; Section6.2 explicitly allows multiple low-value sink components/gates. T20 neither originates nor refutes that general gate account.

next_question_recommendation.priority: Fresh-heldout native000 early/later query-write factorial before a direction ensemble, conditional on a separate prospective protocol and reviews.
next_question_recommendation.why: Observed readout-time reversals make causal transmission across the fixed split immediately informative. T20 splits readouts, not intervention support, so existing data cannot identify which write positions caused later loss.
next_question_recommendation.minimal_question: For each fixed PC/orth matched proposal, apply early q1..126 only, later q127..511 only, both, or neither, with identical full512 execution and baseline bytes on inactive queries/q0; compare predeclared early/later/full outcomes.
next_question_recommendation.paired_target: Cache own native baseline and both full proposals from identical incoming L10 state; keep the same querywise target/FP32 recipe across support subsets. No rematching based on loss or another support subset.
identification_limits: Later-only cannot change earlier prefix outputs in the causal model, but later edits can influence subsequent later queries through L11 K/V: it is not a purely query-local test.

Early-only changes to later losses identify cross-position consequences through the remaining attention block in this architecture; they do not separate K from V, individual heads, or prove PC uniqueness.
On a fixed outcome view, Y(both)-Y(early)-Y(later)+Y(neither) is a finite nonadditivity contrast, not mediation or a fraction. Zero interaction does not imply no early-to-late transmission.
An early/later readout reversal can also reflect local source/position sensitivity, so T20 alone is not evidence that transmission occurs.
followups: Preseeded gate-orthogonal direction ensemble tests specificity to the one orth control. Gate-coordinate orthogonality does not imply orthogonality of actual projected writes.

Pairwise min-norm targets across ensemble members change the matched PC arm per partner; do not reuse one PC matched forward unless a common target for all partners is prespecified. A global minimum changes dose and can shrink it.
Native-specific calibration is a separate transfer/misfit question; fit independently of evaluation losses and do not change directions and causal timing in one unidentifiable comparison.
Retain fresh passage clusters, all four sources, paired starts, fixed execution length and existing scored views; no outcome-selected directions, heads, masks or intervals.
